name: Data Booster
_note: Add-ons catalogue from the business workbook Addons.xlsx (2026-10-25), by category (Local Data, Local Calls, International Calls, Roaming, Combo, Others). mrcQAR is the price in QAR where the workbook gives a fixed QR amount, otherwise 0 with priceLabel carrying the workbook's own wording (TBC, Plan-based, Plan-dependent, QR 10 after promotional period ...); pricing is 'free' only where the workbook says included with an eligible plan. addonStatus is the workbook's, unchanged; the workbook's validity is not carried (a postpaid add-on is monthly, so validity does not apply). A prepaid-only add-on (Local Minutes Booster) is not in this postpaid catalogue. Plan restrictions the workbook words in text (Essential / Extra / Unlimited plans) are not applied: the products carry no plan-family field.
